spectators.name: Edward Elric
spectators.look: short, fiery teen alchemist with long golden-blond hair in a braid, one antenna-like cowlick, sharp gold eyes and a cocky grin, wearing a long red hooded coat over a black jacket and black leather pants, white gloves hiding a metal right arm, black boots and a silver pocket-watch chain at his hip
spectators.fallbackLook: short, fiery teen boy with long golden-blond hair in a braid, a single antenna cowlick and sharp gold eyes, a long red hooded coat over a black jacket and black leather pants, white gloves, black boots and a silver watch chain at his hip
spectators.idle: arms crossed, scowling and stretching up on his toes to look taller
spectators.cheer: clapping his palms together with a small blue spark, grinning
spectators.shocked: hair standing on end, braid flying, teeth bared in outrage

spectators.name: Alphonse Elric
spectators.look: gentle giant who is a huge hollow steel-grey suit of medieval armor: a spiked helmet with a long white plume, two glowing white eye dots in the dark visor slit, big round spiked shoulder pauldrons, thick gauntlets and a red loincloth hanging from the belt, cradling a small grey kitten
spectators.fallbackLook: towering hollow steel-grey suit of medieval armor with a spiked helmet and a long white plume, two glowing white eye dots in the dark visor slit, round spiked shoulder pauldrons, thick gauntlets and a red loincloth at the belt, cradling a small grey kitten
spectators.idle: cupping a tiny kitten in both gauntlets, helmet tilted sweetly
spectators.cheer: one gauntlet cradles kitten against chest; the other bent arm raises a cheering fist; exactly two arms
spectators.shocked: one gauntlet cradles kitten against chest, other hand against helmet; exactly two arms

spectators.name: Roy Mustang
spectators.look: smug young colonel with short black hair hanging over his forehead, dark narrow eyes and a confident smirk, wearing a dark blue military uniform jacket with gold buttons and shoulder boards, blue trousers, black boots and white gloves with a red flame array drawn on the backs
spectators.fallbackLook: smug young military officer with short black hair over his forehead, dark narrow eyes and a confident smirk, a dark blue uniform jacket with gold buttons and shoulder boards, black boots and white gloves with a red circular symbol on the backs
spectators.idle: one gloved hand raised, fingers poised to snap, smirking
spectators.cheer: snapping his fingers with a tiny orange spark, grinning
spectators.shocked: staring at his damp glove in dismay, eyebrows shot up

spectators.name: Riza Hawkeye
spectators.look: composed sharpshooter lieutenant with blonde hair clipped up at the back of her head and a few loose bangs, steady amber eyes, wearing a dark blue military uniform with gold buttons, a black shoulder holster and black boots, a small black-and-white puppy sitting at her feet
spectators.fallbackLook: composed blonde woman officer with her hair clipped up at the back and loose bangs, steady amber eyes, a dark blue military uniform with gold buttons, a black shoulder holster and black boots, a small black-and-white puppy sitting at her feet
spectators.idle: standing at attention, arms folded, watching alertly
spectators.cheer: polite applause with a small warm smile
spectators.shocked: stepping back, eyes wide, one hand moving to her holster

spectators.name: Alex Louis Armstrong
spectators.look: colossal, absurdly muscular major with a shaved head except one curly blond forelock, a huge blond handlebar mustache and bright blue eyes, wearing a dark blue military uniform jacket straining over his muscles and spiked steel gauntlets
spectators.fallbackLook: colossal muscular man with a shaved head and one curly blond forelock, huge blond handlebar mustache, bright eyes, a dark blue military uniform jacket and spiked steel gauntlets
spectators.idle: flexing one bicep proudly, no floating sparkles
spectators.cheer: shirt open in a double-biceps pose, arms bent within own pose column; no floating sparkles
spectators.shocked: manly tears streaming down his face, fists clenched to his chest

spectators.name: Winry Rockbell
spectators.look: spirited young automail mechanic with long blonde hair in a high ponytail with long bangs and big blue eyes, wearing a black tube top, khaki work coveralls with the sleeves tied around her waist and a tool belt, a big steel wrench in her hand
spectators.fallbackLook: spirited young mechanic girl with long blonde hair in a high ponytail and big blue eyes, a black tube top, khaki work coveralls with the sleeves tied around her waist, a tool belt and a big steel wrench in her hand
spectators.idle: tapping the wrench against her palm, studying the fighters' joints
spectators.shocked: hands over her mouth, wrench dangling, eyes teary

spectators.name: Maes Hughes
spectators.look: cheerful, doting officer with short spiky black hair, rectangular glasses and a short stubble beard along his jaw, wearing a dark blue military uniform with gold buttons, eagerly holding up a small photo of his little daughter
spectators.fallbackLook: cheerful officer with short spiky black hair, rectangular glasses and a short stubble beard, a dark blue military uniform with gold buttons, eagerly holding up a small family photo
spectators.idle: holding up the photo of his daughter to show his neighbors, beaming
spectators.cheer: waving the photo out to the side, laughing proudly
spectators.shocked: clutching the photo to his chest, glasses knocked askew

spectators.name: Scar
spectators.look: grim, broad-shouldered avenger with dark brown skin, short spiky white hair, red eyes and a large X-shaped scar across his forehead between the eyes, wearing a mustard-yellow jacket open over a black sleeveless top, light pants and black boots, a dark-blue tattoo pattern running down his right arm
spectators.fallbackLook: grim, broad-shouldered man with dark brown skin, short spiky white hair, red eyes and a large X-shaped scar across his forehead, a mustard-yellow jacket open over a black sleeveless top, light pants, black boots and a dark-blue tattoo pattern down his right arm
spectators.cheer: tattooed right fist held out to the side, a curt nod
spectators.shocked: red eyes wide, stepping back into a guarded stance

spectators.name: Gluttony
spectators.look: short, enormously round homunculus with a bald head, tiny black dot eyes, a huge drooling grin and a finger in his lips, wearing a plain black shirt and pants with a dark bib tied at his neck
spectators.fallbackLook: short, enormously round creature-man with a bald head, tiny black dot eyes, a huge drooling grin and a finger in his mouth, a plain black outfit with a dark bib at his neck
spectators.idle: finger in his mouth, drooling hungrily at the fighters
spectators.cheer: bouncing with both stubby arms raised, giggling
spectators.shocked: mouth wide open in a huge round O, drool flying

spectators.name: Ling Yao
spectators.look: cheerful foreign prince with black hair tied back in a short ponytail and long bangs, eyes in a permanent closed squint-smile, wearing a white high-collared Xingese tunic with gold-yellow trim and loose black trousers, a curved sword at his hip, eating from a rice bowl with chopsticks
spectators.fallbackLook: cheerful young prince with black hair in a short ponytail and long bangs, eyes in a closed squint-smile, a white high-collared eastern tunic with gold-yellow trim, loose black trousers and a curved sword at his hip, eating from a rice bowl with chopsticks
spectators.idle: shoveling rice from the bowl with chopsticks, cheeks full
spectators.shocked: one eye snapping open, rice falling from his chopsticks
